atriccha:

1ca

2ca
ind. [ts], 1. an enclitic conjunctive particle (connecting parts of sentences or whole sentences; when connecting two words, follows both or only the second; when connecting more than two words, follows each word, or some, or only the final word; the first ca is often strengthened with eva); (i) and, both, also; moreover, as well as; Abh 1187 (samuccaye samāhāre ’nvācaye cetarītare … ca casaddo); M I 92,.37 foll. (carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca); 93,.10 foll. (taṃ ca pan’ amhākaṃ ruccati c’ eva khamati ca tena c’ amhā attamānā ti); S I 189,.32 (āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti … te ca bhikkhū … dhammaṃ suṇanti); III 65,.12 (evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sattaṭṭhānakusalo hoti. kathaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu tividhūpaparikkhī hoti); Dhp 256 (yo ca atthaṃ anatthaṃ ca ubho niccheyya panḍito); 261 (yamhi saccaṃ ca dhammo ca ahiṃsā saṃyamo damo); Ud 3,.27 (āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-moggallāno …; Ud-a 57,.18 : casaddo samuccayattho); It 41,.6 (jāgaro c’ assa bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya sato sampajāno samāhito pamudito vippasanno ca; It-a I 172,.26 : casaddo sampiṇḍanattho, tena vakkhamāne satādibhāve sampiṇḍeti); Th 295 (yaṃ c’ amhi putto buddhassa yaṃ ca dhammesu cakkhumā; Th-a II 125,.18 : yan ti yasmā, casaddo samuccayattho); 600 (yaṃ ca aññe na rakkhanti yo ca aññe na rakkhati); Ja I 151,.23 (tuyhaṃ ca tassā ca abhayaṃ dammī ti); 167,.1 (tvaṃ mahāsaddena hasi c’ eva rodi ca); III 82,24* (subhaddako c’ eva supesalo ca); 127,.5 (macchamaṃsena c’ eva phalāphalena ca paṭijaggiṃsu); 190,6* foll. (sā maṃ annena pānena vatthena sayanena ca attanā pi ca …); V 184,22* foll. (koso ca tuyhaṃ vipulo koṭṭhāgāraṃ ca tuyhaṃ paripūraṃ paṭhavī ca tuyhaṃ vijitā); Mil 18,.21 (dibbāni candanacuṇṇāni c’ eva dibbāni ca mandāravapupphāni abhippavassiṃsu); Vism 59,.8 foll. (sīlaṃ c’ eva suparisuddhaṃ bhavissati vatāni ca sampajjissanti); Mhv 6:21 (aṭṭito puttasokena na ca khādi na cāpivi); 25:97 (iti vatvā mahārājā kataññū idam āha ca); Sadd 887,.18 foll. (ca iti anvācaye itaretarayoge samāhāre vyatireke … ca pavattati … anvācaye bhikkhaṃ ca dehi gavaṃ cānehī ti … itaretarayoge samaṇo ca tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo ca tiṭṭhati … samāhāre sītaṃ ca uṇhaṃ ca sītuṇhaṃ …); 903,.21 foll. (ca vā icc ete padāvasāne ca dvinnaṃ samānādhikaraṇapadānaṃ majjhe ca nipatanti na padādimhi, taṃ yathā samaṇo ca brāhmaṇo ca … eso ca samaṇo sādhurūpo eso ca brāhmaṇo sādhurūpo); — (ii) (according to cts) including unexpressed objects similar to that or those expressed: etc; and so on; Sn 118 (gāmāni nigamāni ca; Pj II 178,.30 : ettha casaddena nagarānī ti pi vattabbaṃ); Th 647 (mettaṃ ca abhijānāmi appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ; Th-a II 273,.25 : casaddena karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ cā ti itarabrahmavihāre saṅgaṇhāti); 770 (passa cittakataṃ rūpaṃ maṇinā kuṇḍalena ca; Th-a III 35,.24 : casaddena sesābharaṇālaṅkāre saṅgaṇhāti); Bv 10:5 (pāpuṇī kevalaṃ bodhiṃ buddhañāṇe ca cuddasa; Bv-a 185,.10 foll. : casaddo sampiṇḍanattho, tena aparāni [ñāṇāni] … sakale ca buddhaguṇe pāpuṇī ti attho); Cp 1:4:4 (iti sāyaṃ ca pāto ca ghosāpemi; Cp-a 42,.19 : ettha casaddena majjhantike cā ti āharitvā vattabbaṃ); — (iii) expressing immediate connection between two actions or their simultaneous occurrence; Thī 479 (sā c’ evaṃ bhaṇati pitaraṃ Anīkaratto ca … upayāsi … vāreyyaṃ); 481 (sā ca tahiṃ samāpannā Anīkaratto ca āgato nagaraṃ); 482 (sā ca manasikaroti Anīkaratto ca āruhi turitaṃ); — (iv) in grammatical texts, connecting the statement with words in previous statements; Sadd 330,.17 (kakha hasane: kakhati. jakkha bhakkhane ca, hasanānukaḍḍhanatthaṃ cakāro: jakkhati); 566,.22 (daṃsa daṃsane: daṃseti … dasi dassane ca, cakāro daṃsanaṃ apekkhati); — 2. a disjunctive particle: but, on the other hand; yet; A I 58,.18 (yasmā ca kho bhikkhave sakkā akusalaṃ pajahituṃ); It 3,.30 (sabbaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ … sabbaṃ ca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ; It-a I 54,.12 : casaddo vyatireke); Sn 1003 (sace agāram ajjhāvasati … sace ca so pabbajati agārā anagāriyaṃ); Th 106 (ekaṅgadassī dummedho satadassī ca paṇḍito; Th-a I 227,.18 foll. : paṇḍito pana … sabbaso passati); 130 (yo ca kho annapānassa lābhī hoti ’dha puggalo; Th-a II 10,.20 foll. : casaddo vyatireke … ayaṃ h’ ettha attho, yo pana puggalo …); 276 (pare ca na vijānanti … vijānanti ca ye dhammaṃ …; Th-a II 115,.12 : ye pana satthu sāsanadhammaṃ yathābhūtaṃ jānanti); Thī 128 (yassa maggaṃ na jānāsi … maggaṃ ca kho ’ssa jānāsi); 144 (nakkhattāni namassantā … bālā … ahaṃ ca kho namassantī sambuddhaṃ …); Ja II 110,19* (ciraṃ pi kho taṃ khādeyya gadrabho haritaṃ yavaṃ pāruto sīhacammena, ravamāno ca dūsayi; 110,22´ : attana pana gadrabharavaṃ ravamāno …); 160,11* (mahatī vata te bondi na ca paññā tadūpikā); III 128,3* (adassanena morassa … kākaṃ … apūjesuṃ … yadā ca sarasampanno moro Bāverum āgamā …); Sadd 887,.18 foll. (ca iti … vyatireke … vyatireke yo ca buddhaṃ ca dhammaṃ cā ti gāthāyaṃ yo cā ti ettha casaddo vyatirekatthavācako so ca casaddo pubbe vuttatthāpekkhako … ettha yo cā ti yo panā ti attho); — 3. in the protasis of conditional sentences: if; also frequently in a second conditional clause; (note also ca = but, in a following sentence rejecting the condition); D I 186,.3 (oḷāriko ca hi te … attā abhavissa rūpī … aññā va saññā abhavissa añño attā); II 36,.9 (ahaṃ c’ eva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mam’ assa kilamatho); A I 58,.21 foll. (akusalaṃ ca h’ idaṃ bhikkhave pahīnaṃ … dukkhāya saṃvatteyya, nāhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ akusalaṃ bhikkhave pajahathā ti, yasmā ca kho bhikkhave akusalaṃ pahīnaṃ … sukhāya saṃvattati …); V 87,.22 foll. (ime ca … dasa dhammā loke na saṃvijjeyyuṃ … yasmā ca kho … ime dasa dhammā loke saṃvijjanti); Th 468 (buddho ca me varaṃ dajjā so ca labbhetha me varo; Th-a II 197,.27 foll. : sace buddho bhagavā … mayhaṃ … varaṃ dadeyya) ≠ Ja V 216,1*; Ja V 185,22* (idaṃ ca tuyhaṃ rucitaṃ); VI 208,1* foll. (etaṃ ca saccaṃ vacanaṃ bhaveyya … yasmā ca etaṃ vacanaṃ abhūtaṃ); — 4. an emphatic particle, emphasising the preceding word; an expletive particle; Abh 1187 (padapūraṇamatte ca casaddo avadhāraṇe); D I 207,.6 foll. (atha ca pana bhavaṃ Ānando evam āha atthi c’ ev’ ettha uttariṃ karaṇīyan ti); M I 91,.9 (evaṃ cāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi); Th 675 (rajam ūhataṃ ca vātena yathā meghopasāmaye; Th-a III 4,.12 : ca iti nipātamattaṃ); Ja III 188,.13 (so … Bharukacchaṃ pāpuṇi. tadā ca Bharukacchavāṇijā nāvāya Suvaṇṇabhūmiṃ gacchanti); Sp 879,.19 foll. (sace ca mayaṃ jāneyyāmā ti sace mayaṃ jāneyyāma, cakāro pana nipātamattam eva); Mhv 25:109 (sagga-maggantarāyo ca natthi te tena kammunā); Sadd 887,.18 foll. (ca iti … avadhāraṇādisu ca pavattati); — na ca, and not, rather than; Ja I 153,.2 (ahaṃ rajjaṃ jaheyyaṃ na ca taṃ patiññaṃ); — 5. ca following an interrogative pronoun, makes it indefinite; — see sv ka3; — 6. ca following a relative pronoun probably makes it indefinite, while itself retaining a conjunctive sense; S II 65,.15 foll.
